dialogues.jp:
体育館の裏に行ってみると、珍しく月城が一生
懸命、土をいじっていた。
dialogues.en:
Taking a look behind the gym, I found a curious sight;
Tsukishiro exerting herself with all her heart.
dialogues.text:
Taking a look behind the gym, I found a curious sight;
Tsukishiro exerting herself with all her heart.

dialogues.jp: 「月城、何をしてるんだ？」
dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro, what are you doing?"
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro, what are you doing?"

dialogues.jp:
月城は、例の草の周りをスコップで掘り返し、
なにかを埋めているようだった。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro was digging all around the plant, then scooping
something inside the holes.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro was digging all around the plant, then scooping
something inside the holes.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...This."
dialogues.text: "...This."

dialogues.jp:
少し汚れた手で、そばに落ちているビニール袋
を俺に見せてくれる。
dialogues.en:
One of her dirtied hands motioned to the opened vinyl bag
next to her.
dialogues.text:
One of her dirtied hands motioned to the opened vinyl bag
next to her.

dialogues.jp:
「ナニナニ……、体力の落ちかけている植物に
　絶大な効果！　防虫効果もあり、あなたの大
　切な草花を守ります、か」
dialogues.en:
"Aha... so, protecting your precious plant from the evilness
of insects, and stimulating it's growth!"
dialogues.text:
"Aha... so, protecting your precious plant from the evilness
of insects, and stimulating it's growth!"

dialogues.jp:
月城が、土にその肥料を混ぜこねながら、こく
んと頷いた。
dialogues.en:
She nodded, while continuing to mix the manure with the soil
around.
dialogues.text:
She nodded, while continuing to mix the manure with the soil
around.

dialogues.jp: 確かに、見るからにひ弱そうだものな、その草。
dialogues.en: Looknin at that plant, it does seem to be growing weaker...
dialogues.text: Looknin at that plant, it does seem to be growing weaker...

dialogues.jp: 「効くといいな」
dialogues.en: "Hopefully, it'd work."
dialogues.text: "Hopefully, it'd work."

dialogues.jp:
月城がゆっくりと頷く。ゆっくりではあったけ
れど、それはとても強い信念が見て取れた。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro nodded again, this time slower than usual.
Slower, yet firmer and full of belief.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro nodded again, this time slower than usual.
Slower, yet firmer and full of belief.

dialogues.jp:
月城がそれほどまでに一生懸命花を咲かせよう
としている理由はいったいなんなのだろうか。
dialogues.en:
She really wants to make that plant bloom flowers... I
wonder why.
dialogues.text:
She really wants to make that plant bloom flowers... I
wonder why.

dialogues.jp: 「なあ、やっぱり教えてくれないのか？」
dialogues.en: "Hey, you're still not going to tell me why, huh?"
dialogues.text: "Hey, you're still not going to tell me why, huh?"

dialogues.jp: 月城は、俺の方を見て、首を小さく振る。
dialogues.en:
Tsukishiro turned to me, then gave me a little shake of the
head.
dialogues.text:
Tsukishiro turned to me, then gave me a little shake of the
head.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...I can't."
dialogues.text: "...I can't."

dialogues.jp:
ここへ来て、月城と話をしてはいるが、結局、
俺はまだ彼女のフィールドの中へは入れてもら
えていない気がする。
dialogues.en:
My reason for coming here was to try and talk to Alice, but
in the end, I still can't seem to penetrate her A.T Field.
dialogues.text:
My reason for coming here was to try and talk to Alice, but
in the end, I still can't seem to penetrate her A.T Field.

dialogues.jp: 「水、汲んできてやろうか？」
dialogues.en: "Shall I get some water for the plant?"
dialogues.text: "Shall I get some water for the plant?"

dialogues.jp:
月城は、んー……としばらく何かを考えるよう
に、首を傾げていたが、
dialogues.en:
As usul for her thinking, her head tilted to the side,
until,
dialogues.text:
As usul for her thinking, her head tilted to the side,
until,

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……お願い、します」
dialogues.en: "...Yes, please."
dialogues.text: "...Yes, please."

dialogues.jp: と言った。
dialogues.en: She eventually replied.
dialogues.text: She eventually replied.

dialogues.jp:
手頃なものが見つからず、校舎の隅に転がって
いたバケツを捕まえて、それに水を汲んだ。
dialogues.en:
Not being able to find anything appropriate around, I
eventually settled on a bucket at a deserted corner of the
school.
dialogues.text:
Not being able to find anything appropriate around, I
eventually settled on a bucket at a deserted corner of the
school.

dialogues.jp:
少しだけ持っていっても、足りなければ、無駄
足になると、少々多めに入れておいた。
dialogues.en:
I didn't want to make several trips back and forth, so I
filled it to the brim.
dialogues.text:
I didn't want to make several trips back and forth, so I
filled it to the brim.

dialogues.jp: 大は小を兼ねると、よく言うからな。
dialogues.en:
She didn't say whether she wanted a lot or a little, after
all.
dialogues.text:
She didn't say whether she wanted a lot or a little, after
all.

dialogues.jp:
俺は、水をたっぷり汲んだバケツを手に持ち、
体育館裏に戻る。
dialogues.en:
With a bucket full of water in hand, I returned to the gym
rear.
dialogues.text:
With a bucket full of water in hand, I returned to the gym
rear.

dialogues.jp: 「月城ー。水汲んできたぞー」
dialogues.en: "Tsukishiro-, I'm back with water-"
dialogues.text: "Tsukishiro-, I'm back with water-"

dialogues.jp:
帰ってきたら、ちょうど肥料をやり終えたとこ
ろで、まさに水を待っていた状態だった。
dialogues.en:
By the time I came back, she appeared to have finished
burying all the manure, and was just awating the water.
dialogues.text:
By the time I came back, she appeared to have finished
burying all the manure, and was just awating the water.

dialogues.jp: 「これだけあれば、困らな……って、わわあ！」
dialogues.en: "With this much, it shouldn't be a...w, wahhh!"
dialogues.text: "With this much, it shouldn't be a...w, wahhh!"

dialogues.jp: ──バッシャーン
dialogues.en: --*crash*
dialogues.text: --*crash*

dialogues.jp: ──ざばー
dialogues.en: --*Splaaash*
dialogues.text: --*Splaaash*

dialogues.jp:
石にけつまづいた俺は、持っていたバケツの中
身を一気にぶちまけてしまった。
dialogues.en:
I stepped on a rock on the ground, losing my balance and
falling forward, emptying the bucket's contents in front of
me.
dialogues.text:
I stepped on a rock on the ground, losing my balance and
falling forward, emptying the bucket's contents in front of
me.

dialogues.jp:
水は、体育館裏一面に潤いを与えてしまい、も
ちろん、月城の草には必要以上に潤いを与えて
しまった。
dialogues.en:
The water fell onto the ground, of course, right around
Tsukshiro's plant. That had to be far more water than it
needed.
dialogues.text:
The water fell onto the ground, of course, right around
Tsukshiro's plant. That had to be far more water than it
needed.

dialogues.jp: 「わ、悪ィ、月城！」
dialogues.en: "S, sorry, Tsukishiro!"
dialogues.text: "S, sorry, Tsukishiro!"

dialogues.jp:
水は、辺りに水たまりを作り、ゆっくりとしみ
こんでいった。
dialogues.en: A puddle started to form, slowly soaking into the ground.
dialogues.text: A puddle started to form, slowly soaking into the ground.

dialogues.jp:
草の辺りは、ほぐして柔らかくなってたせいで
他の場所よりひどくぐしゃぐしゃになっていた。
dialogues.en:
Thanks to the digging up that Tsukishiro did, the area
around the plant was completely soaked.
dialogues.text:
Thanks to the digging up that Tsukishiro did, the area
around the plant was completely soaked.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「ホントにすまない……」
dialogues.en: "I'm really, really sorry..."
dialogues.text: "I'm really, really sorry..."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、ふるふると首を横に振りながら、濡れ
ていないところから土を掘り起こして、濡れた
部分に足していた。
dialogues.en:
She simply shook her head, and started digging up more of
the soil, supplementing the soaked portion with it.
dialogues.text:
She simply shook her head, and started digging up more of
the soil, supplementing the soaked portion with it.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……大丈夫」
dialogues.en: "...It's okay."
dialogues.text: "...It's okay."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……このくらいなら」
dialogues.en: "...This will fix it."
dialogues.text: "...This will fix it."

dialogues.jp:
俺も、月城に倣って新しい土を足して、綺麗に
ならしていく。
dialogues.en:
Mimicking Alice, I started to do the same thing to the
drenched soil.
dialogues.text:
Mimicking Alice, I started to do the same thing to the
drenched soil.

dialogues.jp: 努力の甲斐あって、どうにか元通りになる。
dialogues.en:
With a lot of effort, the fertilizer and soil eventually
returned to what it was before my mishap.
dialogues.text:
With a lot of effort, the fertilizer and soil eventually
returned to what it was before my mishap.

dialogues.jp: 「これで、大丈夫だな」
dialogues.en: "It should be fine now."
dialogues.text: "It should be fine now."

dialogues.jp: ふぅとようやく一息つき、額を拭う。
dialogues.en: I wiped my forehead, sighing in relief.
dialogues.text: I wiped my forehead, sighing in relief.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Senpai."
dialogues.text: "...Senpai."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp:
「ん、ああ……。悪かったな。逆に邪魔しちゃっ
　たりして」
dialogues.en:
"Uh, ahh... it was my fault. I'm sorry, I just got in the
way..."
dialogues.text:
"Uh, ahh... it was my fault. I'm sorry, I just got in the
way..."

dialogues.jp: ふるふると首を振る月城。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro shook her head, this time fiercer than usual.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro shook her head, this time fiercer than usual.

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……ありがとう」
dialogues.en: "...Thank you."
dialogues.text: "...Thank you."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "Huh?"
dialogues.text: "Huh?"

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.jp: 「……ありがとう」
dialogues.en: "...Thank you."
dialogues.text: "...Thank you."

dialogues.jp:
月城は、もう一度、ただ『ありがとう』とだけ
言ったのだった。
dialogues.en: Repeating herself, she said a simple "Thank you" again.
dialogues.text: Repeating herself, she said a simple "Thank you" again.

dialogues.jp:
「また、来てもいいかな。今度は邪魔はしない
　からさ」
dialogues.en: "I'd come another time. Next time, I won't mess up."
dialogues.text: "I'd come another time. Next time, I won't mess up."

dialogues.speaker: Alice
dialogues.en: "...Okay."
dialogues.text: "...Okay."

dialogues.jp: 月城は、そう言ってこくんと頷いた。
dialogues.en: Tsukishiro said, with a nod.
dialogues.text: Tsukishiro said, with a nod.

dialogues.jp: ◆大洪水◆
dialogues.en: ◆Big Flood◆
dialogues.text: ◆Big Flood◆

dialogues.jp:
たまには月城の手伝いでもしようかと、水を汲
みに行く俺。
dialogues.en:
Attempting to help out Tsukishiro, I went to fetch some
water.
dialogues.text:
Attempting to help out Tsukishiro, I went to fetch some
water.

dialogues.jp:
しかし、あろうことか、汲んできた水を地面に
向かってぶちまけてしまった。
dialogues.en:
But thanks to unsavoury events, I spilt it all onto the
ground.
dialogues.text:
But thanks to unsavoury events, I spilt it all onto the
ground.

dialogues.jp:
手伝おうとして、邪魔をしてしまうなんて、俺
もバカだ……。
dialogues.en:
Instead of helping, I became a nuisance. What an idiot I
was...
dialogues.text:
Instead of helping, I became a nuisance. What an idiot I
was...

dialogues.jp:
でも、月城は、そんな俺に向かって『ありがと
う』と言ってくれたのだった。
dialogues.en:
But Tsukishiro didn't criticize me. Instead, all she said
was "Thank you".
dialogues.text:
But Tsukishiro didn't criticize me. Instead, all she said
was "Thank you".

dialogues.jp:
俺の気持ちはわかっていてくれてるってことか
な……。
dialogues.en: Perhaps she understood my good intentions...
dialogues.text: Perhaps she understood my good intentions...
